note: CI: end-to-end check that the OpenAPI document vespera generates (examples/axum-example/openapi.json) works with the @devup-api TypeScript client generator. A new e2e/devup-api Bun workspace (run by `bun test` in the lint job) generates the typed client with pinned @devup-api/generator, type-checks sample calls with tsc --noEmit (path/query params, JSON body, Option<T> optional+nullable, enums, nullable $ref anyOf, multipart, the 422 envelope; @ts-expect-error probes guard against untyped output) and asserts the requests @devup-api/fetch builds. No vespera output change was needed.
